description: This file defines the Aws\Sns\SnsClient class, which provides an object-oriented interface to interact with the Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) API. It uses PHP doc comments to specify the methods available for SNS operations, including both synchronous and asynchronous variants.

classes.name: SnsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon SNS, extending the core AWS client functionality and adding SNS-specific methods.

methods.name: addPermission
methods.description: Adds a permission to a topic for service principals.

methods.name: checkIfPhoneNumberIsOptedOut
methods.description: Checks whether a phone number is opted out of receiving SNS SMS messages.

methods.name: confirmSubscription
methods.description: Confirms a subscription to an SNS topic.

methods.name: createPlatformApplication
methods.description: Creates a platform application object for push notifications.

methods.name: createPlatformEndpoint
methods.description: Creates an endpoint for mobile app push notification.

methods.name: createSMSSandboxPhoneNumber
methods.description: Creates a sandbox phone number for SMS testing.

methods.name: createTopic
methods.description: Creates an SNS topic.

methods.name: deleteEndpoint
methods.description: Deletes an endpoint.

methods.name: deletePlatformApplication
methods.description: Deletes a platform application.

methods.name: deleteSMSSandboxPhoneNumber
methods.description: Deletes an SMS sandbox phone number.

methods.name: deleteTopic
methods.description: Deletes an SNS topic.

methods.name: getDataProtectionPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the data protection policy associated with an SNS resource.

methods.name: getEndpointAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes of an endpoint.

methods.name: getPlatformApplicationAttributes
methods.description: Returns attributes for a platform application.

methods.name: getSMSAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the current SMS attributes.

methods.name: getSMSSandboxAccountStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the SMS sandbox account.

methods.name: getSubscriptionAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes of a subscription.

methods.name: getTopicAttributes
methods.description: Returns all of the properties of a topic.

methods.name: listEndpointsByPlatformApplication
methods.description: List endpoints for a platform application.

methods.name: listOriginationNumbers
methods.description: Lists the origination numbers available for sending SMS messages.

methods.name: listPhoneNumbersOptedOut
methods.description: Lists phone numbers that have opted out of receiving SMS messages.

methods.name: listPlatformApplications
methods.description: Returns a list of platform applications.

methods.name: listSMSSandboxPhoneNumbers
methods.description: Lists the sandbox phone numbers.

methods.name: listSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns a list of the requester's subscriptions.

methods.name: listSubscriptionsByTopic
methods.description: Returns a list of the requester's subscriptions to a topic.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists the tags assigned to a resource.

methods.name: listTopics
methods.description: Returns a list of topics.

methods.name: optInPhoneNumber
methods.description: Opts in a phone number to receive SMS messages.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Sends a message to an SNS topic or direct to a phone number.

methods.name: publishBatch
methods.description: Creates a batch message for publishing.

methods.name: putDataProtectionPolicy
methods.description: Attaches a data protection policy to an SNS resource.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a permission from a topic.

methods.name: setEndpointAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes of an endpoint.

methods.name: setPlatformApplicationAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes of a platform application.

methods.name: setSMSAttributes
methods.description: Sets the default settings for the SMS short code.

methods.name: setSubscriptionAttributes
methods.description: Allows a subscription owner to set an attribute of the subscription.

methods.name: setTopicAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes for a topic.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Prepares to subscribe an endpoint to an SNS topic.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Attach tags to an SNS resource.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Deletes a subscription to a topic.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from an SNS resource.

methods.name: verifySMSSandboxPhoneNumber
methods.description: Verifies an SMS sandbox phone number.
